name: PC & serial
description: PC and serial: RS-232 and RS-485 signals and levels; the RS-232 DTE and RS-485 (PROFIBUS DP) pinouts on DE-9; USB 2.0 on a Type-A plug; a null-modem cable, an RS-485 cable to a terminated adapter board and a USB LED supply lead. Device profiles for the resolver: a PC serial port, an RS-232 instrument, an RS-485 field device and a plug-on RS-232 to RS-485 converter board, with an RS-485 termination recipe.
